Sub-bullet 3 covers that a genuinely interactive TUI-keypress ceremony is not solved by that requirement and must be tagged requires: "operator". [oracle: grep -q 'requires: "operator"' .claude/agents/subagent-auditor.md]
No semantic content is added or removed: all three original concerns survive verbatim in meaning; the change is formatting/scanability only. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]
templates/agents/subagent-auditor.md is NOT changed. [oracle: git diff --name-only HEAD -- templates/agents/subagent-auditor.md is empty]
